sequences.title: VK-only Read Coils: The report describes a heap-based buffer overflow in `read_io_status` in `src/modbus.c`. It was observed when the `tests/unit-test-client` utility executed `modbus_read_bits(ctx, UT_BITS_ADDRESS, UT_BITS_NB + 1, tab_rp_bits)` at `tests/unit-test-client.c:363` and received a mutated Read Coils response. The normal response `001100000006ff0101300026` was changed by modifying the Modbus ADU `unitId` from `0xff` to `0x7c`, producing `0011000000067c0101300023`. Under AddressSanitizer, this caused a size-1 heap write in `read_io_status` at `src/modbus.c:1207`, reached from `modbus_read_bits`, and the client crashed with a reported `heap-buffer-overflow`.
